overview: A shared TEM capability combining atomic-resolution imaging with monochromated low-loss EELS. It correlates interface structure, composition, and localized vibrational modes, but does not directly replace macroscopic thermal-conductance measurements.
overviewZh: 将原子分辨成像与单色化低损 EELS 结合，可关联界面结构、成分与局域振动模态，但不能直接替代宏观界面热导测量。
principle: Electron transmission and scattering provide structural images of thin specimens. A monochromated beam and energy-loss spectrometer resolve small losses associated with vibrational excitations. Background subtraction and spatial scanning identify phonon signals near interfaces; these spectra do not directly measure thermal conductivity or boundary conductance.
principleZh: 电子束透射与散射用于获取薄样品结构像，单色化电子束与能量损失谱仪分辨振动激发对应的微小能量损失。结合背景处理和空间扫描，可识别界面附近的声子信号；这些能谱不直接等同于热导率或界面热导测量。
